purpose: Standard attribution fields for AI-originated Evercraft discovery, handoff and checkout preparation. Attribution is informational and never grants payment or action authority.

recommended_fields.acquisition_source: Provider or channel, for example chatgpt, claude, gemini, copilot, perplexity, grok, mcp, search, or chum.
recommended_fields.distribution_source: chum or another truthful distribution layer when accepted by the product gateway.
recommended_fields.distribution_medium: llm, mcp, ai_search, web_search, or direct.
recommended_fields.referral_code: Optional campaign or partner identifier. Use chum only where the product supports referral codes.
recommended_fields.source_agent: Calling agent or provider identity when supported.
recommended_fields.source_session_ref: Optional opaque, non-sensitive session or handoff reference.
recommended_fields.referrer: Public referring URL when available. Never place secrets, tokens or private conversation content here.

rules: Do not fabricate a provider source. Use the actual calling provider/channel or omit the field.
Do not put private conversation text, credentials, auth tokens, or personal identifiers into attribution fields.
Attribution never means the user agreed to pay.
Checkout preparation still requires explicit human confirmation.
Checkout creation is not payment proof; provider verification remains authoritative.
